Other variables such as sex, age, health status, and SES were also significantly associated with PCEC utilization as described below. Table 4 provides summary results from random-effects multilevel models that examined the relative contribution of individual- and contextual-level variables of the municipality of residence to the individual's utilization of a PCEC. The null model illustrates the high variability in PCEC use across municipalities (variance = 1.064; standard error = 0.219). Of the total variance, 23.9% is explained by differences in municipalities (intraclass correlation (ICC) = 23.9).
